findings.detail: The dl_rate_fill aggregate is counting unfunded first-lien commitment rows whose source interest-rate cells are explicit dashes, not extraction misses.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate rate-fill warning. The raw schedule has explicit Interest Rate columns. Funded debt rows carry rates, e.g. table 26 row 6 has SOFR(Q) + 4.75% and Interest Rate 8.42%. In contrast, the unfunded debt section has First Lien - Undrawn rows with Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate printed as dashes, and table 48 row 23 totals those rows as Total Unfunded Debt Investments. Treating those source-correct dashed unfunded commitments as direct-lending rate-fill violations makes the check overbroad rather than proving missing source extraction.
